propositions: An author-facing CLI/library/MCP verb `rebar attach-commits` enables retroactive linking of commits to a ticket by recording a COMMITS event.
SHA validation occurs in the seam before recording; any invalid SHA in a batch blocks the entire batch (all-or-nothing) and names all offenders.

A deterministic close-gate check in close_precheck.py blocks close if a commit's changed paths are not covered by file_impact declarations or exemption globs (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md).
Source-(ii) commits (discovered from rebar-ticket: trailers) failing git inspection fail closed; source-(i) commits (from state.commits) are skipped if absent locally.
Merge commits are explicitly skipped, not read as empty path lists; path matching uses POSIX normalization and **/‐aware glob semantics, with directories matched by trailing slash or existence.

The shared helper glob_match is centralized in commit_impact.py (no rebar.llm import) and delegated to by prompts and registry copies; _referencing_commit_exists keeps its bool contract while _referencing_commits returns SHA lists.
